snippet.title: [OUTDATED] Pixplorer : A 2D Sandbox Action-RPG - Official Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Pixplorer is a sandbox action-RPG that merges a 3D world with a 2D art style. Players can explore a procedurally generated universe, find diverse biomes, craft weapons, build houses, uncover hidden dungeons, battle monsters, and level up their characters. Whether you’re constructing a cozy home, mastering real-time combat, or hunting rare fish and insects, it's your unique adventure!

I'm super happy to present it to you! Feedback is highly appreciated in the comments :)

- Ability to build in 3D with blocks
- Very fun dynamic combats with spells, parry, dodge etc.
- 16 biomes
- 100+ weapons & 40+ spells
- 30+ monsters
- 100+ fish and insects to capture
- Increase your stats with farming and fighting
- Many structures and dungeons to find
- Hidden secrets and puzzles !
- Infinite world with real-time procedural generation

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3966650/Pixplorer/ 
Twitter: https://x.com/WhiaxHC 
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/whiaxhc.bsky.social
Reddit: https://reddit.com/r/pixplorer/

Music by: 
- Gregor Quendel - https://www.gregorquendel.com/cinematictrailermusic
- Abstraction - http://abstractionmusic.bandcamp.com/

(this is a re-upload to fix the audio of the old video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3-i8Vopt54k )
